title: Naltrexone for alcohol use disorder: ClinicalTrials.gov posted results only
intro: Randomized trials of naltrexone (oral or extended-release) against placebo with a posted drinking outcome after at least 4 weeks of treatment, from query.cond=alcohol&query.intr=naltrexone, filter AREA[HasResults]true (60 records, 2026-10-15). Inclusion, outcome rule and the general/comorbid classification were written down from the search listing before any outcome data were read (naltrexone-prereg.md). Outcome: the posted heavy-drinking measure at end of treatment where posted, otherwise drinks per drinking day or per week, otherwise drinking frequency or abstinence. Dropped on reading: NCT02026011 (1-hour lab self-administration), NCT00366626 (7 days of treatment), NCT00656630 (drinking posted at week 1 only), NCT00511836, NCT00338962 and NCT01723384 (no drinking outcome posted), NCT00817089 (lab challenge only), NCT01296646 (posted only within four sweet-liking and craving strata without per-arm counts).

studies.label: ALK21-003, XR-NTX 190 and 380 mg (Garbutt 2005)
studies.outcome: Percentage of Heavy Drinking Days Over the Treatment Period
studies.measure: % heavy drinking days, 24 wk (median and IQR)
studies.note: posted as medians with IQR; mean and SD estimated (Wan 2014); both doses combined. The posted Andersen-Gill hazard ratios are 0.751 (380 mg) and 0.830 (190 mg)

studies.label: ALK21-014, XR-NTX after enforced abstinence
studies.outcome: Cumulative Percentage of Participants by Heavy Drinking Rate
studies.note: counts rebuilt from the posted 40.8% and 47.3% with 0% heavy drinking days
